title: Print Navbar Plain Heading Chip
description: Navbar top right should show the current chapter name inside the chip. Currently empty in zwischenbericht and other templates.
summary: Changed print running-header selection to retain the highest heading tier encountered. In the Zwischenbericht, part names now own the outer header chip; lower headings repeat the retained part mark to supersede KOMA numbered marks without replacing the part label. SemioNavShort is consumed on ignored lower levels so it cannot leak. Added focused regression assertions, a retained debug probe, and rendered verification captures. The print quick suite passed; the real Zwischenbericht built in light and dark; pages 10-27 were audited and visually checked for Ergebnisse, Projektstand, Mittelverwendung, and Ergebnisverwertung; report, paper, and kompaktbericht light/dark fallback builds also passed.
